title: Relic reported missing at Hazratbal
detail: Idrees Kanth's article abstract dates the theft to 27 December 1963; the 1965 committee report also dates the reported disappearance to that day.

title: Disturbances reported in Khulna
detail: The Committee of Enquiry dates the beginning of disturbances in Khulna to 3 January 1964. This is the committee's account, based on evidence gathered in India.

title: Relic reported found
detail: The Committee of Enquiry says the relic was found on 4 January 1964. This is the committee's account.

title: Army called in at Khulna, according to report
detail: The committee quotes a newspaper report saying the army was called in at Khulna on the evening of 4 January to quell disturbances. This is the committee’s account of a contemporary press report.
